payload.text: The notice has one route: the wrapper keeps its decision and its text and runs the app's own executable, "$MENUZ_EXEC" --notify, with the text exported as MENUZ_NOTICE and never passed as an argument, in place of osascript, the Runner exporting MENUZ_EXEC; the --notify arm (refused as usage, exit 2, with MENUZ_NOTICE unset or empty) posts through UNUserNotificationCenter under the app's bundle id, waits for the centre's answer, prints 'notice posted' and exits 0, or prints why and exits 1 (notifications off, naming System Settings > Notifications; not yet allowed while the first launch's alert is up or was withdrawn, naming the alert and the setting, told from off by the centre's status since macOS 27 raises the one error for both; the add error; no answer in 10 s), which the wrapper logs under the run id; the app requests authorisation at its first launch, logs after 10 s with no answer that macOS is asking, and logs the answer when it comes (granted; denied naming the setting; not yet allowed naming the alert and the setting; or the centre's error), and Notifier posts the app's own notices through the same centre; no osascript, no file under state, no summary at the next launch.
